doc.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
doc.interviewee: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack")

title: Closing remarks and a photograph
summary: Allen thanks them, notes the tape is nearly out and takes photographs at their home.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: You have a good memory to remember those fellas because they were just sort of, you know, worked along with you, the show, you know, like hired help, you might say, and they weren't a real part of the show always. I mean, they weren't as important as the singers and dancers, and I'm surprised you remembered all those musicians. It's really wonderful. Well, I don't want to bother you more. We're just about out of this tape here, so if you don't mind, I'd like to snap a picture. You don't have to worry about being dressed up or anything. Oh! Just have a picture here at home. They can tell us at home.
Oh, what? Don't take no picture here. Well, all right.
I'll take it. Take Matthew. I'll take you by and then do you, Mr. Matt.
Well, I mean, you don't look bad at all. You're not looking bad at all. No, you don't look bad. I mean, if it's a bus picture, you don't have to show it.
We can have the background, you know, so they can see it's in your home. They'll know it's no studio. Take it in the kitchen, even. Well, take it in the usual place.
Well, I want to have my dressing in. Tip stuff
